title: Small talk and introductions
intro: Small talk builds trust before business starts. Learn to introduce yourself and others, choose safe topics, keep the chat going and leave it politely.
introBn: কাজের আগে ছোট আলাপ সম্পর্ক তৈরি করে। নিজের ও অন্যের পরিচয়, নিরাপদ বিষয়, কথা চালানো আর ভদ্রভাবে শেষ করা শিখুন।

units.title: Introducing yourself and others
units.idea: Give your name, role and one friendly detail. When you introduce others, say who they are and add something they share, so the conversation can start.
units.ideaBn: নাম, কাজ আর একটা ছোট তথ্য বলুন। অন্যকে পরিচয় করানোর সময় দুজনের মিল আছে এমন কিছু বলুন, যাতে কথা শুরু হয়।

formula.name: Yourself
formula.pos: Hi, I'm Rafi. I work in the marketing team. · I've just joined the company.

formula.name: Others
formula.pos: Rafi, this is Sara from Finance. · Sara, have you met Rafi?

formula.name: Reply
formula.pos: Nice to meet you. · Nice to meet you too. · Good to see you again.

uses.rule: Use 'I'm' or 'My name is' + first name. Don't say 'Myself Rafi'.
uses.ex: Hi, I'm Rafi. I'm from Rajshahi.

uses.rule: Introduce others with 'This is…', not 'He is…'.
uses.ex: Sara, this is Mr Ahmed, our new client.

uses.rule: 'Nice to meet you' the first time; 'Nice to see you' after that.
uses.ex: Nice to see you again, Karim!

uses.rule: Add a detail to start talking.
uses.bn: কথা চালাতে একটা তথ্য যোগ করুন।
uses.ex: Sara, this is Rafi. He's from Rajshahi too.

uses.rule: Present perfect for new things: I've just joined.
uses.ex: I've just started in the IT department.

traps.wrong: I am working here since March.
traps.right: I've been working here since March.

drills.q: First day at a Dhaka office.
drills.s: Hi, ___ Rafi. I've just joined the sales team.
Mr Lee, ___ my manager, Ms Rahman.

drills.q: You met Karim last month. Today you see him again.
আমি রাজশাহী থেকে এসেছি, এটা আমার প্রথম চাকরি।
o: I'm from Rajshahi, and this is my first job.
Myself from Rajshahi, my first job is this.
I am coming from Rajshahi, this is first job.
I'm from Rajshahi, and this my first job.
drills.a: I'm from Rajshahi, and this is my first job.

drills.s: Sara, have you ___ Rafi? He's handling your account.
I've ___ joined the company, so I'm still learning.

units.title: Keeping a conversation going and ending it
units.idea: Choose safe topics (work, weather, travel, food), ask follow-up questions, show you share things with 'So do I' or 'Neither do I', and close politely with a reason.
units.ideaBn: নিরাপদ বিষয় বেছে নিন, পাল্টা প্রশ্ন করুন, So do I / Neither do I দিয়ে মিল দেখান, আর কারণ দেখিয়ে ভদ্রভাবে কথা শেষ করুন।

formula.name: Follow up
formula.pos: Oh really? How long have you been there? · What was that like?

formula.name: Agree
formula.pos: So do I. · So am I. · Neither do I. · Me too. · Me neither.

formula.name: End
formula.pos: Anyway, I'd better get back to work. · It was great talking to you.

uses.rule: Avoid salary, age, marriage, religion with new people.
uses.bn: নতুন মানুষকে বেতন, বয়স, বিয়ে নিয়ে প্রশ্ন নয়।
uses.ex: How was your weekend? (not: How much do you earn?)

uses.rule: Ask a follow-up question, not only yes/no.
uses.bn: শুধু হ্যাঁ/না নয়, পাল্টা প্রশ্ন করুন।
uses.ex: You went to Cox's Bazar? How was it?

uses.rule: So + auxiliary + I for positive; Neither + auxiliary + I for negative.
uses.bn: হ্যাঁ বাক্যে So do I, না বাক্যে Neither do I।
uses.ex: I love biryani. So do I. / I don't drink coffee. Neither do I.

uses.rule: Match the auxiliary: am, do, have, can.
uses.ex: I'm tired. So am I. / I've been to Sylhet. So have I.

uses.rule: End with a signal + reason + nice line.
uses.bn: শেষ করতে সংকেত, কারণ আর ভালো কথা।
uses.ex: Anyway, I'd better go. My meeting starts at three. It was lovely chatting!

signals: it was great talking to you

traps.right: I like tea. Me too. / So do I.
traps.bn: 'আমিও' = Me too বা So do I।

traps.wrong: I don't like traffic. Me too.
traps.right: I don't like traffic. Me neither. / Neither do I.
How are you finding the new job?
traps.why: Salary is too personal for small talk.

drills.q: Colleague: 'I'm from Rajshahi.' You are too.
Client: 'I don't eat spicy food.' You don't either.
Pick the best follow-up to 'I just got back from Singapore.'
o: Oh, nice! Was it for work or a holiday?
How much did it cost you?
drills.a: Oh, nice! Was it for work or a holiday?

drills.q: Pick the safest small-talk question for a new client.
Colleague: 'I've never been to Sylhet.' You haven't either.
যাই হোক, আমাকে এখন কাজে ফিরতে হবে। কথা বলে ভালো লাগল।
o: Anyway, I'd better get back to work. It was great talking to you.
Anyway, I must return my work. Talking was nice.
Anyway, I'd better to get back to work. It was great to talking.
drills.a: Anyway, I'd better get back to work. It was great talking to you.

drills.q: Ending a chat at a conference.
drills.s: Well, I ___ let you go. Enjoy the rest of the event!
drills.x: I should let you go = polite close.

drills.q: Colleague: 'I can't stand Dhaka traffic.' You agree.
drills.s: Neither ___ I. It took me two hours today.

mastery.s: Hello, ___ Rafi Hasan from the Dhaka office.
I love working from home. So ___ I.

mastery.q: Pick the correct reply to 'I'm not a morning person.'
mastery.x: Negative with am → Neither am I.

mastery.q: আপনি কি রাফির সাথে পরিচিত হয়েছেন?
o: Did you meet with Rafi already?

mastery.s: It was great ___ to you. See you at the meeting!
mastery.x: It was great talking to you.

mastery.s: Rahim! It's so good to ___ you again.
